_comment: Literal token strings used by altais-mcp's vulnerability detection patterns. These are pattern data, NOT executable code: altais-mcp scans target source for these tokens, it never calls them. Keeping the literals in this JSON data file (instead of inline in TypeScript) stops supply-chain scanners such as Socket.dev from misreading the detection patterns as real eval / network / shell usage. Loaded by src/core/scan-patterns.ts.

dangerous_functions.name: js-dynamic-code
dangerous_functions.description: JavaScript's dynamic code-execution primitive: compiles and runs a string as code. The canonical code-injection sink (CWE-95).

dangerous_functions.name: js-function-constructor
dangerous_functions.description: The Function constructor builds a callable from a string body — equivalent to dynamic code execution for code-injection purposes (CWE-94).

network_access.name: web-http-request
network_access.description: The fetch() API performs outbound HTTP requests. Relevant to server-side request forgery (SSRF, CWE-918) detection.

shell_access.name: node-process-module
shell_access.description: Node.js module that spawns operating-system processes.

shell_access.name: shell-command
shell_access.description: exec()-family call: runs a command line through a shell (CWE-78).

shell_access.name: shell-command-sync
shell_access.description: Synchronous exec(): runs a command line through a shell and blocks (CWE-78).

shell_access.name: process-launch
shell_access.description: spawn()-family call: launches a child process directly.

shell_access.name: process-launch-sync
shell_access.description: Synchronous spawn(): launches a child process and blocks.

shell_access.name: libc-system
shell_access.description: C standard-library system() call: runs a command through /bin/sh (CWE-78).

shell_access.name: libc-popen
shell_access.description: C standard-library popen() call: runs a command through a shell and returns a stream.

shell_access.name: py-subprocess-module
shell_access.description: Python module that runs and manages child processes; shell=True enables command injection (CWE-78).

shell_access.name: py-os-system
shell_access.description: Python os.system(): runs a command through the shell (CWE-78).
